identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][Observatory][bug] Restore complete conversation transcripts from Runtime history

values.summary: Trace the current history and UI restore paths, add a complete bounded Runtime history representation for both roles, invoke restoration during fresh connection, deduplicate replay, and prove the full isolated reload behavior.

steps.action: Trace production conversation admission completion persistence history serialization and Observatory connection flows; establish stable ordered turn identity and privacy boundaries.
Implement complete conversation_history.v1 production history and wire fresh Observatory reload restoration with exact-once replay handling.
Add and run focused deterministic tests plus the isolated production-path reload/reconnect acceptance until both transcript halves restore exactly once.
Obtain independent exact-head review, fix findings, and publish a non-draft PR without merging.

invariants: Every visible transcript entry is Runtime-authorized
Private agent memory never enters operator history
Reload does not depend on browser-local state
Validation does not touch the permanent Runtime
risks: History could disclose non-public payload fields
Completion events may lack outbound text
UI restoration could race with the first feed snapshot
stop_conditions: A duplicate open issue owns the same defect
